item.description:
NotchCanvas 2.0.2
The lock-screen music player now uses clear Liquid Glass instead of frosted widget glass, without the notch's black fade.
Restores extension-free system Now Playing integration in the website edition on macOS 15.4 and later, including compatible browser media. The lock-screen player works independently of the Reminders or Player tab selection.
Adds reminder status labels that sync through Reminders Notes while preserving your existing notes. Hides the compact content cue on secondary displays without changing the primary notch or expanded views.
Shows recent Codex chats with their chat names, improves active-session detection for long conversations, and refines agent usage and reminder text sizing.
Introduces a one-time agent approval setup prompt after welcome or update. Agent approvals remain opt-in and require a supported local hook; installing the app alone does not connect arbitrary desktop chats.
Liquid Glass requires macOS 26 or later. Earlier systems use a native material fallback. Agent approval actions require a supported, explicitly connected provider hook.
